tips:
## Noun Patterns (משקלים - Mishkalim)

Hebrew nouns often follow predictable patterns called **mishkalim** (משקלים). Recognizing these patterns helps you guess meanings of new words!

### Pattern: מִקְטָל (miktál) — Place Nouns
This pattern often indicates a **place** where an action happens:

| Word | Root | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| מִסְעָדָה | ס.ע.ד (to dine) | restaurant (place of dining) |
| מִסְפָּרָה | ס.פ.ר (to cut hair) | barbershop |
| מַעֲבָדָה | ע.ב.ד (to work) | laboratory (place of work) |
| מִרְפָּאָה | ר.פ.א (to heal) | clinic (place of healing) |

### Pattern: מַקְטֵל (maktél) — Tool/Instrument Nouns
This pattern often indicates a **tool** or instrument:

| Word | Root | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| מַפְתֵּחַ | פ.ת.ח (to open) | key (thing that opens) |
| מַחְשֵׁב | ח.שׁ.ב (to think) | computer (thing that computes) |
| מַכְשִׁיר | כ.שׁ.ר (to be fit) | device/instrument |

### Pattern: מִכְתָּב (miktáv) — Result/Product Nouns

| Word | Root | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| מִכְתָּב | כ.ת.ב (to write) | letter (thing written) |
| מִשְׂחָק | שׂ.ח.ק (to play) | game (thing played) |

### Other מ- Nouns
- **מָלוֹן** (malon) — hotel (from לון, to lodge)
- **מָקוֹם** (makom) — place (from קום, to stand)
- **סִפְרִיָּה** (sifriyah) — library (from ספר, book + suffix -iyah for place)
- **מְכוֹנָה** (mekhonah) — machine (from כון, to set up)

Learning these patterns is like getting a superpower — you can often guess a word's meaning from its shape!
